mapper.sql: c.id, c.post_id, c.nickname, c.content, c.status, c.created_at, u.avatar_url, c.parent_id, c.reply_to_nickname, (select count(*) from comment_like l where l.comment_id = c.id) as like_count, (select count(*) > 0 from comment_like l where l.comment_id = c.id and l.ip_hash = #{ipHash}) as liked
mapper.select: select from comment c left join app_user u on u.id = c.user_id where c.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into comment (post_id, parent_id, reply_to_nickname, nickname, content, status, ip_hash, user_id) values (#{postId}, #{parentId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{replyToNickname}, #{nickname}, #{content}, #{status}, #{ipHash}, #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT})
mapper.update: update comment set status = #{status} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(*) from comment_like where comment_id = #{commentId} and ip_hash = #{ipHash}
mapper.insert: insert into comment_like (comment_id, ip_hash, user_id) values (#{commentId}, #{ipHash}, #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT})
mapper.delete: delete from comment_like where comment_id = #{commentId} and ip_hash = #{ipHash}
